title: Shared artifact definitions
description: Vocabulary reused by every run artifact. Defined once so a field cannot mean one thing in a plan and another in an analysis. references/artifacts.md owns the prose contract.

version.description: Artifact format version. Bumped only when a change makes an in-flight run unresumable rather than merely older.

schemaRef.description: Identifier of the schema this artifact claims to satisfy, so a reader can validate it without knowing which coordinator wrote it.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time restricted to the UTC 'Z' offset, which is what state.now() emits and the only form every consumer reads identically. The pattern rather than `format: date-time` because format is an unchecked annotation unless a validator opts in, and because RFC 3339 alone would also admit a local offset.

text.description: Prose a human must be able to act on, so whitespace alone does not satisfy it.

relativePath.description: A path inside the run's target. Traversal and absolute forms are rejected imperatively in state.safe_relative_path, because a pattern cannot express what is inside a directory.

identifier.description: A stable lowercase key used to join artifacts across phases.
